the mechanisms of synaptic plasticity, which is a fundamental property of the nervous system.
the morphological plasticity of spines in the hippocampus.
the mechanisms underlying long-term potentiation, and long-term depression.

CPP is not a perfect NMDA receptor antagonist and that the effects of CPP are more complicated than originally thought.

CPP blocks the induction of LTP and the induction of morphological changes, but does not affect morphological changes induced by LTD.

The main takeaway from our work is that

LTP and LTD are not just a simple strengthening or weakening of the synapse, but rather a complex process that involves changes in both pre- and post-synaptic compartments, as well as spine structure.
